sources.title: GitHub - Ayesshaabbas/wheat-diseases-detection-website: This Wheat ...
sources.snippet: This Wheat Disease Detection System is a web app that uses a deep learning model to identify diseases in wheat leaves from images. Built with Flask and SQLite, it features user login and detection history. The project aims to support early, accessible disease diagnosis for farmers using AI and web technology.

sources.title: AI-Powered Wheat Farming Assistant with Disease Detection
sources.snippet: The project also includes an AI-Powered Chatbot using Ollama + Llama3.2 that answers any wheat farming question locally without internet.
